name: Daisounan
source:
In the future, when interplanetary travel has become common, a spaceship accident leaves 9 people trapped on an unexplored planet.
The survivors have to find a way to escape the planet (which in the worst case might only be possible for two of them, while the rest are left behind)) while battling the Fauna and Flora of the planet (and possibly each other)

[url=/v882]Nangoku Dominion[/url] in space.
